meanings.en: located on a higher floor of a building

meanings.en: in a friendly or affectionate way

meanings.en: a comfortable heat, or friendliness

meanings.en: a soft solid substance used to make candles

meanings.en: a fault or lack of strength

meanings.exampleTr: Gemi şafakta batıya doğru yelken açtı.

meanings.tr: her ne zaman, ne zaman olursa
